description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells.
Cast Molten Duplication by paying {1}{R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Molten Duplication, creating a token copy of Cormela.
Put the tapped Cormela into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Cormela dies, it triggers, returning Molten Duplication from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
